status.description: OPEN while any member is still open; COMPLETED when the last open member completed; ABANDONED when every member left without completing.

cpt.description: The batch's priority band — every member shares this CPT instant.

formed_at.description: The formation instant; the walk's `walk_seconds` on WorkBatchCompleted is measured from it.

stop_seq.description: The 1-based visit order of this stop (hint rank order, ADR 0063 D6).

compartment.description: The cart position holding this task's items; v1 assigns it by stop order.

state.description: The member's state inside the walk. DETACHED means the task's lease expired and it returned to the pool through the existing sweep.

batch.description: The formed walk, or null when the anchor was claimed as an ordinary single task because it has no pick face (ADR 0062) — the claim stands exactly as `task-claims` would have left it.

anchor_task_id.description: The task ClaimNext would have returned — batching never changes who goes first.
